name: Ninja: Bamboo Assassin 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Ninja: Bamboo Assassin is a casual ninja game that plunges you into the perilous world of ninja arts, where every move counts and could be the difference between life and death.  How to Play Ninja Bamboo Assassin Your mission in Ninja: Bamboo Assassin is to stealthily navigate dense bamboo forests, using your blade to cut through the thickets and approach enemies without being noticed.
